summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 728KB payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs an obfuscated setup.mjs that downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js — a 728KB single-line obfuscator.io-style blob (rotated string arrays, hex identifiers, shift/rotate string decoder) shipped inside the tarball. Both the setup.mjs launcher and the math_init.js payload are obfuscated. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: shipped payload code is invoked through a freshly-downloaded alien runtime rather than through Node, evading Node-based install-time inspection. The behavior fires automatically on npm install with no user consent. The package's declared purpose is repository configuration / lint-staged / commitlint helpers, which does not require Bun or a 700KB obfuscated blob. Installing this version executes attacker-controlled bundled code on the installer's machine under an alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
